purpose: Projects unify conversations, documents, objects, connectors, plans, tasks, memory, automations, agents, and artifacts. Typed handoffs (YOU→CHAT, CHAT→IDE, IDE→YOU) carry claim capsules with provenance, never capabilities.

crate.name: hide-you
crate.rationale: Same crate as swarms: projects and handoffs are YOU-surface product contracts that share Surface / SurfaceCapability / claim-only capsule types.

handoff_capsules.law: Every transfer between surfaces creates a TYPED capsule, never a flattened transcript. A capsule never widens permission.
handoff_capsules.invariant: a capsule never widens permission. Receiving a capsule in CHAT does not grant CHAT the connector access YOU held when it was created. The capsule carries the CLAIM, never the CAPABILITY.

kinds.carries: implementation campaign: goal, constraints, prior research with evidence tiers, decisions and why, explicitly out-of-scope items
repository/worktree and verification plan: branch, files in play, tests that must pass, what reviewers should look at
release summary: what changed, what was verified, what remains, and a personal/project update

every_capsule_carries: evidence tiers of any claim it asserts
permissions it was created under (PermissionSnapshot — audit only)
what it deliberately excludes and why

type_boundary.receive_api: SurfaceSession::receive(&self) → ReceivedHandoff; capability field not mutated

capability_derivation.non_widening: SurfaceCapability fields are private; no public grant/add/widen API

grade_ceiling: READY_FOR_INTEGRATION — fixtures and mocks never earn PRODUCTION
